summary: Build traceable ESG metrics, data-quality checks and reporting workflows aligned with IFRS S1, IFRS S2 and the GHG Protocol. Explore the course.
lede: ESG data engineering links sustainability metrics to source records and disclosure requirements in traceable reporting workflows. For sustainability, finance and data professionals, the course addresses how to map metrics to disclosures, define data ownership and document calculation methods. You’ll also develop data-quality checks and design spreadsheet-based collection, validation and review workflows.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who collect, validate, govern or report ESG information and need to connect source data with disclosure requirements. It suits intermediate learners with some exposure to sustainability reporting, finance reporting or data workflows.
modules: IFRS S1 and S2 Disclosure Scoping
prerequisites: Working familiarity with ESG or sustainability reporting, finance reporting, or organizational data workflows is expected. Routine spreadsheet use is required; no programming is required.
